item.title: Exclusive video shows Cornell University Faculty Senate meeting
item.description: Exclusive video offers insight into Wednesday's high-stakes meeting at Cornell University.

item.title: Houthis launch new attack on Saudi capital as Trump mulls strikes
item.description: Iran's Houthi allies launch a new attack on Saudi Arabia and promise more to come as Trump considers U.S. action on the new front line in the wider Mideast war.

item.title: DOJ tells California to review whether noncitizens got mail ballots
item.description: The Justice Department has ordered California to review a list of people who the federal government believes may have received mail-in ballots for the upcoming election despite not being U.S. citizens.

item.title: Watch: Chaos erupts in France as student protesters clash with police
item.description: A new wave of student protests erupted across France on Tuesday over what activists describe as poor school conditions, including overcrowded classrooms and teacher shortages. See the footage from the massive demonstrations.

item.title: Fossil overlooked for 100 years ID'd as new dinosaur species
item.description: A fossil discovered 100 years ago in the U.K. has been identified as a previously unknown cousin of the T. rex, and it "definitely would have chased us."

item.title: Animation depicts newly-discovered dinosaur species
item.description: Scientists in the U.K. have discovered a new dinosaur species, the Invictibellatrix amberina, a two-legged carnivore that was a cousin of the Tyrannosaurus rex. The fossil that led to the discovery sat in a drawer at the Natural History Museum in London for nearly 100 years, having first been obtained by the vaunted institution in 1924.

item.title: Mystery of Amelia Earhart's plane could be solved in days
item.description: A group of American researchers believes it may be days away from finding what remains of the missing plane of legendary aviator Amelia Earhart off a remote island in the South Pacific.

item.title: Why AI could end the price tag as we know it
item.description: Retailers want to harness the power of artificial intelligence to set personalized prices for shoppers, a consumer protection expert says.

item.title: Pope's cancer prognosis may depend on these factors, doctors say
item.description: Pope Leo XIV was diagnosed with lung cancer after a surgery that removed a nodular lesion from his right lung, the Vatican said.

item.title: OpenAI sued by 8 states over claims ChatGPT coached kids to harm themselves
item.description: ChatGPT maker OpenAI is being sued by eight states over the claims the chatbot allegedly coached kids to harm themselves and others. Tristan Harris, co-founder and president of the Center for Humane Technology, joins "The Daily Report."

item.title: After teen notices older man's beat-up shoes, he gives up his own pair. Now, they talk every day.
item.description: When a teenager in Arizona noticed an older gentleman with shoes nearly falling off his feet, he offered up his own. Now, they've been talking every day since. Tony Dokoupil has the story.

item.title: Inside the search for Amelia Earhart, who vanished in 1937
item.description: For nearly 90 years, CBS News has been following one of the world's biggest mysteries: what happened to Amelia Earhart? American researchers now believe they may have found what remains of her plane. Lana Zak has the story.

item.title: Details as police investigate alleged sexual assault off University of Chicago's campus
item.description: Police are investigating a newly reported sexual assault at an off-campus fraternity house near the University of Chicago. Lilia Luciano reports.

item.title: U.S. may have withheld warnings to Ukraine on deadly Kyiv strikes
item.description: The Trump administration may have withheld intelligence warnings to Ukraine about Russian strikes that killed 6 and cut power to 600,000 people, sources say.

item.title: Florida man charged with murder in ex-fiancée's 2011 disappearance
item.description: Michelle Parker disappeared the same day that an episode of "The People's Court" aired that featured Parker and the suspect, Dale Smith Jr., in a contentious dispute over an engagement ring.

item.title: Ukrainian officials accuse U.S. of withholding intelligence, leading to Russian missile attack
item.description: Ukrainian officials suspect the U.S. has been withholding information about incoming Russian air strikes. The U.S. has threatened to do so if Ukraine continues striking Russian energy targets, which President Trump blames for driving up diesel prices. Aidan Stretch reports.

item.title: Inflation surged in September as U.S. energy costs jumped
item.description: Gas prices, which jumped 9.1% in September from August, accounted for more than half the monthly rise in inflation.

item.title: Ilhan Omar's relatives subpoenaed as part of immigration probe
item.description: The subpoenas were issued on Friday, just days before Omar's home in Washington, D.C., was searched early Monday morning by investigators from ICE's investigative unit.

item.title: 911 call shows Hayden Panettiere was given CPR on day she died
item.description: Zach Hickerson, the brother of Hayden Panettiere's on-again, off-again boyfriend, Brian Hickerson, called 911 and attempted CPR on the actress before she was declared dead.

item.title: Man arrested in ex-fiancée's disappearance 15 years after going on "The People's Court" together
item.description: In Orlando, police said they broke a cold case that began nearly 15 years ago, when a couple appeared on "The People's Court." The woman disappeared soon after, and now her ex-fiancée is under arrest. Cristian Benavides reports.

item.title: Trump insists inflation is low as CPI report shows a 3.7% increase
item.description: President Trump hunted for silver linings in the higher-than-expected September inflation numbers. The surge in prices was fueled by a 9% month-over-month jump in gas prices. Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: AI could allow retailers to charge people different prices for the same item, experts warn
item.description: Experts are warning that AI could allow retailers to use personal data for dynamic pricing, potentially causing some to pay more for the same items. CBS News MoneyWatch reporter Megan Cerullo breaks down the story.

item.title: Gymnastics coach who recorded girls in bathroom gets 90 years
item.description: The judge gave the maximum sentence possible to Sean Gardner, 39, who pleaded guilty to placing a hidden camera in a bathroom at a gymnastics studio in Purvis, Mississippi.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere 911 call released detailing CPR efforts to save her life
item.description: Nearly two months after actress Hayden Panettiere died of a drug overdose, CBS News has newly released 911 calls, revealing frantic efforts to save her life. Mark Strassmann reports.

item.title: Iowa Senate candidates Turek and Hinson face off in final debate amid razor-thin race
item.description: Iowa Senate candidates Josh Turek, a Democrat, and Ashley Hinson, a Republican, faced off in a heated debate Tuesday night amid their razor-thin midterm race. CBS News' Zak Hudak breaks it down.

item.title: 10/14: CBS Evening News
item.description: Pope Leo is recovering from lung cancer surgery, the Vatican says; a 911 call was released two months after Hayden Panettiere's death.

item.title: Pollster Frank Luntz on midterms, 20 days from Election Day
item.description: CBS News polling has shown Latino support for Republicans is far below what it was in 2024. Pollster Frank Luntz joins "The Takeout" to discuss the state of the midterms with 20 days until Election Day.

item.title: Climate change pushed Earth to its limits in 2026, researchers find
item.description: Climate change has pushed the planet's environmental systems "deeper into uncharted territory," researchers said in a new report centered on the state of Earth's climate in 2026.

item.title: Police seize robot that allegedly groped a teenage girl
item.description: German police have seized a humanoid robot after it allegedly touched a 16-year-old girl in an indecent manner and made sexually suggestive gestures.

item.title: Becerra, Hilton face off in California gubernatorial debate
item.description: Candidates Xavier Becerra and Steve Hilton faced off in their first one-on-one debate ahead of the November election for California governor.
